paite: Huan David in tang vum kahkhiakna akhen zek nung in, ngai in, Mephibosheth sikha Ziba in sabiltung nih toh ana dawn hi. Sabiltung nihte'n tanghou beu zanih, grep phoukeu bawk zakhat, nipithei zakhat leh uain thawl khat apua uhi.
heading: David Leh Ziba
english: When David was a little past the top, behold, Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth met him with a couple of donkeys saddled, and on them two hundred loaves of bread, and one hundred clusters of raisins, and one hundred summer fruits, and a container of wine.

paite: Kumpipa'n Ziba kiang ah, "Hiaite bangchidan ahia?" achi hi. Ziba in, "Sabiltungte kumpipa inkuanpihte tuanna ding ahi, Tanghou leh nipitheite tangvalte nek ding; uain bel gamdai a bah peuhmahte dawn ding ahi," achi hi.
english: The king said to Ziba, “What do you mean by these?” Ziba said, “The donkeys are for the king’s household to ride on; and the bread and summer fruit for the young men to eat; and the wine, that those who are faint in the wilderness may drink.”

paite: Kumpipa'n, "Ahihleh na pu tapa koi ah?" achi hi. Ziba in kumpipa kiang ah, "Ngai in, Jerusalem ah a-om. 'Tuni in Israel inkote'n ka pa lalgam ahon pekik nawn ding uh, chi a angaihtuah ziak in,' " achi hi.
english: The king said, “Where is your master’s son?” Ziba said to the king, “Behold, he is staying in Jerusalem; for he said, ‘Today the house of Israel will restore me the kingdom of my father.’”

paite: Kumpipa'n Ziba kiang ah, "Ngai in, Mephibosheth thil neih tengteng nang a ahi vekta," achi hi. Ziba in, "Ka toupa, kumpipa aw, na mitmuh a deihsakna mu ding in kingainiamtak in ka hon ngen," achi hi.
english: Then the king said to Ziba, “Behold, all that belongs to Mephibosheth is yours.” Ziba said, “I bow down. Let me find favor in your sight, my lord, O king.”

paite: Kumpipa David, Bahurim atun in, ngai in, Saul inkote lak a mi Gera tapa, amin Shimei ahong pawtkhia a; hamsia lou kawmkawm in ahong paitou hi.
heading: David Leh Shimei
english: When King David came to Bahurim, behold, a man of the family of Saul’s house came out, whose name was Shimei, the son of Gera. He came out and cursed as he came.

paite: Suang in David adeng a, kumpipa David sikha tengteng leng; mi tengteng leh sepaih hat tengteng ataklam leh veilam ah a-om uhi.
english: He cast stones at David and at all the servants of King David, and all the people and all the mighty men were on his right hand and on his left.

paite: Shimei in hamsiat in hichi in achi, "Paimang vengveng in, paimang vengveng in, nang sisan suah hat leh Belial mipa:
english: Shimei said when he cursed, “Be gone, be gone, you man of blood, and wicked fellow!

paite: Asik a vai na hawm Saul inkote tengteng sisan TOUPA'N na tung ah ahon kiksak nawnta. TOUPA'N gam na tapa Absalom ana pe khinta. Ngai in, sisan suah hatmi na hih ziak in nangmah siatna na kitun ve," achi hi.
english: Yahweh has returned on you all the blood of Saul’s house, in whose place you have reigned! Yahweh has delivered the kingdom into the hand of Absalom your son! Behold, you are caught by your own mischief, because you are a man of blood!”

paite: Huchi in Zeruiah tapa Abishai in kumpipa kiang ah, "Bangziak a hiai ui sisa in toupa, ka pu hamsiat mawkmawk ahia? Ka kuantou ding a alu ka tansak mai ding?" achi hi.
english: Then Abishai the son of Zeruiah said to the king, “Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? Please let me go over and take off his head.”

paite: Kumpipa'n, "Nou Zeruiah tapate aw, nou na hon theihsak ding uh bang a-om a? TOUPA'N akiang a, David hamsiat in, achihleh ahamsiat ahi mai kei dia. Bangziak a huchibang a hih kua'n achi dia?" achi hi.
english: The king said, “What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah? Because he curses, and because Yahweh has said to him, ‘Curse David,’ who then shall say, ‘Why have you done so?’”

paite: David in Abishai leh asikhate tengteng kiang ah, "Ngai un, ka tapa, ka gil a gah mahmah in hon thah atum. Hiai Benjamin mi'n nak tup sem na'n chia! Bangmah loh kei unla, hamsia ahihleh loh hen. TOUPA hihsak ahi,
english: David said to Abishai and to all his servants, “Behold, my son, who came out of my bowels, seeks my life. How much more this Benjamite, now? Leave him alone, and let him curse; for Yahweh has invited him.

paite: TOUPA'N ka haksatna ahon mu dia, TOUPA'N tuni a hon hamsiat ahoih lam in hon thuk nawn kha maithei hi,” achi hi.
english: It may be that Yahweh will look on the wrong done to me, and that Yahweh will repay me good for the cursing of me today.”

paite: Huchi in David leh amite lampi ah apai zel uh. Shimei bel agal tang pang ah apai zel a, apai kawm in ahamsiat zom zel a, suang in adeng a, leivui in atheh hi.
english: So David and his men went by the way; and Shimei went along on the hillside opposite him and cursed as he went, threw stones at him, and threw dust.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa leh akiang a mi om tengteng Aiphim atungta uh. Huchi in huai ah akhawl tawldam uhi.
english: The king and all the people who were with him arrived weary; and he refreshed himself there.

paite: Absalom leh Israel mi tengteng Jerusalem ah ahoh ua, alak uah Ahithophel leng atel hi.
heading: Jerusalem Ah Absalom
english: Absalom and all the people, the men of Israel, came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel with him.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Arki mi Hushai, David lawm, Absalom kiang atun in Absalom kiang ah, "Pathian in kumpipa humbit hen, Pathian in kumpipa humbit hen," achi hi.
english: When Hushai the Archite, David’s friend, had come to Absalom, Hushai said to Absalom, “Long live the king! Long live the king!”

paite: Absalom in Hushai kiang ah, "Hichibang ahi maw na lawm na hehpihna dan? Bangziak a na lawm kiang a hoh lou?" achi hi.
english: Absalom said to Hushai, “Is this your kindness to your friend? Why didn’t you go with your friend?”

paite: Hushai in Absalom kiang ah, "Ka hoh kei ding. TOUPA leh hiai mite leh Israel mi tengteng atelpa uh thuthu in ka om dia, akiang ah ka om zaw ding.
english: Hushai said to Absalom, “No; but whomever Yahweh and this people and all the men of Israel have chosen, I will be his, and I will stay with him.

paite: Kua nna ka sem dia? Atapa ma ah nna ka sem ding ahi kei maw? Na pa ma a ka sep bang in nangmah ma ah ka sem ding,” achi hi.
english: Again, whom should I serve? Shouldn’t I serve in the presence of his son? As I have served in your father’s presence, so I will be in your presence.”

paite: Absalom in Ahithophel kiang ah, "Bangchi in i hih diam aw, na ngaihdan gen dih ve," achi hi.
english: Then Absalom said to Ahithophel, “Give your counsel what we shall do.”

paite: Ahithophel in Absalom kiang ah, "Na pa mei, inn ngak a akoihte kithuahpih in. Israel mi tengteng in na pa'n nang hon mudah chih ana za ding ua; nang lam a pang tengteng khut ahat ding," achi hi.
english: Ahithophel said to Absalom, “Go in to your father’s concubines that he has left to keep the house. Then all Israel will hear that you are abhorred by your father. Then the hands of all who are with you will be strong.”

paite: Absalom a ding in inn tung ah puanin akai uh. Huchi in Israel mi tengteng mitmuh in apa meite akithuahpih hi.
english: So they spread a tent for Absalom on the top of the house, and Absalom went in to his father’s concubines in the sight of all Israel.

paite: Huai lai in Ahithophel lem theihnate, Pathian thu dongpa lemtheihna bang ahi a; huchi mah bang in David leh Absalom in leng Ahithophel ana ngai uhi.
english: The counsel of Ahithophel, which he gave in those days, was as if a man inquired at the inner sanctuary of God. All the counsel of Ahithophel was like this both with David and with Absalom.
